summary: Tested DJ unified wall feature: backend 'all' slug support for /wall/posts, /wall/chat, /wall/users; DM from/to_location_slug persistence; partner_location_slug projection in conversations. Frontend LocationTag rendering conditioned on isDJ flag. All 9 backend pytest cases pass; frontend Playwright verifies DJ sees location tags across 4 unique locations on Feed and Chat while guests see zero tags and hit per-location endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: DMs tab is hidden when guestMode=true (SocialWallPage.jsx line 1318). Since setting only ff_dj_profile in localStorage without a real user profile leaves the user in guest mode, a 'DJ' guest cannot access DMs. If DJs are expected to DM from any location without a full user profile, consider relaxing the DMs tab visibility check when is_dj is true. Currently by design, so not a bug — flag for product confirmation.
get_wall_users for 'all' fetches up to 200 posters + 200 chatters — may become expensive at scale. Consider pagination or DB-side de-duplication.

Stale wall posts contain legacy location_slug values like 'midtown' (vs canonical 'midtown-atlanta'). LocationTag renders them raw; consider mapping/validating against the locations collection or a fallback label.
test_credentials: None required (public endpoints; DJ mode set via localStorage.ff_dj_profile)
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed posts/chats/DMs across edgewood-atlanta and midtown-atlanta. Not cleaned up (small volume). Prefix TESTUNI_ used for content markers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_wall_unified.py covers 'all' slug pattern for posts/chat/users, DM location field persistence, and partner_location_slug projection. Frontend flow: FEED and CHAT tabs use data-testid='tab-feed'/'tab-chat'; LocationTag elements have data-testid='location-tag-{slug}'. DMs tab only shown when !guestMode — real DJ profiles (via /api/user/profile) get DMs; localStorage-only DJs do not.
